#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed Satisfactory server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/satisfactory/worldcradle-homes/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export HOME="<ROOT>/installs/satisfactory/worldcradle-homes/test"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/satisfactory/" || exit 1
exec ./FactoryServer.sh -Port=7779 -ReliablePort=8889 -unattended -LOG=worldcradle-test.log \
    '-ini:Game:[/Script/Engine.GameSession]:MaxPlayers=4'

#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed graceful stop: save, then let systemd's stop signal shut it down.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
"<PYTHON>" - 7779 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SAVE'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<APP>')
import config, monitor
port = int(sys.argv[1])
token = config.load().get('satisfactory_api_token') or monitor.satisfactory_login(port, sys.argv[2])
if token:
    state = monitor.satisfactory_state(port, token) or {}
    monitor.satisfactory_save(port, token, state.get('activeSessionName') or 'worldcradle_save')
SAVE
exit 0
